operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Protect adds a password and permissions; unlock removes them (you need the open password if the PDF asks for one).

files.title: PDF URLs
files.description: Direct links to PDFs. Through the API each item can carry its own password: { "url": "…", "password": "…" }.

password.title: Password
password.description: Protect: the password that will open the PDFs. Unlock: the password that opens them now. Used for every file without its own.

passwords.title: Per-file passwords
passwords.description: Optional map of PDF URL → password, e.g. one password per employee payslip.

restrictOnly.title: Restrictions only (no open password)
restrictOnly.description: The PDF opens for anyone, but printing/copying/editing follow the permissions below.

allowCopy.title: Allow copying text and images
allowCopy.description: Readers may select and copy content.

allowAnnotate.title: Allow comments
allowAnnotate.description: Readers may add comments and highlights.

allowForms.title: Allow filling forms
allowForms.description: Readers may fill in form fields.

allowAssemble.title: Allow page changes
allowAssemble.description: Readers may insert, rotate or delete pages.

ownerPassword.title: Owner password
ownerPassword.description: Guards the permissions. Leave empty for a random one nobody knows (the safest choice).

zip.title: Bundle into one ZIP
zip.description: Also saves pdfs.zip with every result.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
